_comment: Licence questions that block a -stable release only (Round 17; docs/LICENSING-AUDIT.md). Set resolved to true, with what was decided, once each is settled.

jamendo.why: Jamendo's API is free for non-commercial use only and forbids offline caching; Lumen saves tracks into the library.

esri.why: The map's satellite layer fetches Esri World Imagery with no key; a commercial app needs an ArcGIS account and key, or another provider.
